title: MIPS GIC · recursive gic_lock acquisition
pattern: gic_set_affinity() holds gic_lock and calls gic_set_type(), which attempts to acquire that same raw spinlock.
detected_source_sites: Acquisition sites: lines 384 and 307 · nested call: line 410
limitation: The cycle has an uncertain summary. In the fixed source, guard(raw_spinlock_irqsave) is not extracted, so the zero-cycle result is not complete lock coverage.

title: 8250 serial · IRQ descriptor and port lock order
pattern: The upstream lockdep report describes conflicting port->lock and IRQ descriptor lock order; the fix moves disable_irq_nosync() before taking port->lock.
limitation: disable_irq_nosync() remains unresolved, and this run covers only 8250_port.c; IRQ descriptor and printk/console paths are outside its translation unit.

title: qedi · hard-IRQ reentry on per-CPU work lock
pattern: The upstream fix describes qedi_cpu_offline() holding p_work_lock with hard IRQs enabled while qedi_msix_handler() can interrupt and reach qedi_process_completions(), which acquires the same per-CPU lock.

fixed.analysis_status: not analyzed with a matching Kbuild database

limitation: This affected-source run remains a miss: both lock sites now have the same symbolic qedi_percpu[current_cpu].p_work_lock identity, but IRQGuard emits no dependency or cycle for the interrupt reentry. The fixed source was not rerun in this comparison.
